info.title: Sigma Reseller API
info.description:
API used by Reseller API integrations to manage customers, resellers,
DNS, discount coupons, packages, servers, reports, and webhooks.

Authenticate each request with the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.
Create tokens from the panel's Reseller API integration page; each
token's plaintext is shown exactly once.

An account may hold several named tokens, each independently editable
and revocable. Every token carries explicit action scopes: an operation
is allowed only when the token has the scope listed in that operation's
`x-required-scope` (otherwise `403 insufficient_scope`) and the account
still holds any permission the scope requires (otherwise
`403 permission_denied`). Every call also returns `403 permission_denied`
when the panel owner removed the `use reseller api` permission from the
account's role. A token may also be locked to IPv4/IPv6
addresses or CIDR networks; calls from any other source address get
`403 ip_not_allowed`. Tokens without an IP list work from any address.

The `/me/webhooks*` operations are panel-session only: they require a
panel login credential and never accept a Reseller API token.

## Rate limits and response headers

Authenticated token requests share 120 requests per minute per user per tenant,
across all of that user's tokens. Rotating tokens does not reset the quota.
Normal responses that pass the throttle include `X-RateLimit-Limit` (maximum
requests per minute) and `X-RateLimit-Remaining` (requests left after this call).
On application quota exhaustion, HTTP `429` also includes `Retry-After`
(seconds to wait) and `X-RateLimit-Reset` (Unix timestamp in seconds).
Reset and retry headers are not sent on normal responses.

Inspect headers with a safe read request:
`curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $SIGMA_API_TOKEN" "$SIGMA_API_BASE_URL/me"`,
where `SIGMA_API_BASE_URL` is this contract's server URL.
In server-side JavaScript, read `response.headers.get('x-ratelimit-remaining')`;
in Python requests, read `response.headers.get('X-RateLimit-Remaining')`.
Headers are HTTP metadata, not JSON body fields, and names are case-insensitive.
AI-generated clients must preserve status and headers, pace shared workers,
and honor `Retry-After` on `429` rather than retrying immediately.
If headers are missing, do not assume unlimited quota: authentication failures
and upstream Nginx/Cloudflare responses may omit them. Use bounded backoff
with jitter when no retry delay is provided; never blindly replay mutations.
Failed authentication has a separate 10-attempt/minute per-IP bucket whose
`429` returns only `Retry-After`. Public documentation and panel-session
webhook management do not use the authenticated token quota.

tags.name: customers
tags.description: Customer CRUD plus lifecycle actions (renew, change package, courtesy days, resync, server migration).

tags.name: coupons
tags.description: Discount coupons for your customers' renewal checkout, with usage counts.

tags.name: resellers
tags.description: Reseller CRUD plus credit actions (add, remove, recharge).

tags.name: dns
tags.description: Your own DNS and your direct resellers' DNS, with change history.

tags.name: reports
tags.description: Aggregate reports — counts, memberships, low credits, new resellers, expiring.

tags.name: webhooks
tags.description: Per-user webhook subscriptions with HMAC-signed deliveries.

get.description: Non-sensitive profile snapshot used by SDKs to bootstrap.

Newest first. Filters can be combined. To fetch one known username,
use `GET /customers/by-username/{username}` instead of paging.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description:
Partial match: returns every customer whose username contains this
value. Values shorter than 3 characters are ignored.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: `ACTIVE`/`INACTIVE` return only unexpired customers with that status; `EXPIRED` returns customers past `expires_at`.

get.description:
Returns the single customer you own whose username equals the path
value exactly. Unlike `GET /customers?username=`, longer usernames
that merely contain the value are not returned.

409.description: More than one of your customers uses this username; list them with `GET /customers?username=` and use the customer id.

post.description:
Renews on the current package and connections unless `package_id` or `connections` is sent.
The package must belong to the customer's server and cannot be a trial package.
Renewing a trial customer converts it to a paid customer.
Credits are charged for the selected package and connections.

package_id.description: Hashid of a non-trial package on the customer's server. Defaults to the current package.

connections.description: Connections after renewal. Defaults to the current connections, within the package and panel limits.

400.description: Renewal refused (unknown or trial package, invalid connections, not enough credits); message states the reason.

post.summary: Add courtesy days to a customer

put.description:
Server migration must be enabled in the panel settings.
The target server must differ from the current one, be `ACTIVE`, and be allowed for your account.
The package must be a non-trial package of the target server.
Trial customers and customers with additional servers cannot be migrated.
No customer on the target server may already use the same username.
When the panel blocks migrations to packages with more connections, a package with more connections than the current one on the same connection type is refused.
If the new package has fewer connections, the customer's connections are reduced to match, with no credit refund.
The customer is recreated on the target server and removed from the old one. No credits are charged, and bouquets reset to the new package's defaults.

package_id.description: Hashid of a non-trial package that belongs to the target server.

400.description: Migration refused; message states the rule that blocked it.

get.description: Newest first. Filters can be combined.

parameters.name: customer_id
parameters.description: Hashid of one of your customers. Returns only coupons limited to that customer; an unknown id returns an empty list.

post.description:
Sigma generates the code. The customer enters the code on the renewal page, or opens the
customer's `renew_url` (from `GET /customers/{customer}`) with `?promocode=<code>` appended.
Set `max_uses: 1` for a single-use coupon.
Every checkout order created with the coupon counts as a use, paid or not. Check `paid_count` to see paid uses.

delete.description: The code stops working at checkout. Orders that already used it keep their discount.

get.description: Newest first. The page size is fixed at 25.

Your own DNS for each IPTV server available to you. `dns` is your own
value (`null` when unset); `inherited_dns` is the value playlists use
when you have none.

put.description:
Sets your own DNS for one IPTV server; `null` clears it. Returns `403`
with only `message` when the server is not available to you.

get.description:
One row per DNS set by your direct resellers, per server. Only direct
resellers are listed, regardless of depth permissions.

parameters.name: server_id
parameters.description: Hashid of a server; only its DNS rows are returned.

get.description: DNS rows of one direct reseller. Any other reseller returns `404`, regardless of depth permissions.

parameters.name: server_id
parameters.description: Hashid of a server; only its DNS row is returned.

put.summary: Set or clear one reseller's DNS
put.description:
Sets the DNS of one direct reseller for one server. Setting creates or
overwrites the value; `null` clears it. Any other reseller returns
`404`, regardless of depth permissions. Returns `403` with only
`message` when the server is not available to you.

post.description:
Replaces `search` with `replace` on every matching DNS of your direct
resellers (only direct resellers, regardless of depth permissions).
The comparison ignores case, surrounding spaces and trailing slashes.
Limit it to one server with `server_id`.

Copies your own DNS for one server to your direct resellers (only
direct resellers, regardless of depth permissions). Mode `empty` fills
only resellers without a DNS for that server; `all` overwrites every
direct reseller. Returns `422` on `server_id` when you have no own DNS
for that server, and `403` with only `message` when the server is not
available to you.

get.description: DNS changes made to you and to your direct resellers, newest first.

parameters.name: batch_id
parameters.description: Hashid of a change batch; only its rows are returned.

post.description:
Restores the previous DNS of every entry in one change batch. Entries
changed again since then are skipped. Returns `404` for a batch that
changed none of you or your direct resellers, `403` when it also
changed someone deeper, and `422` on `batch_id` when it was already
reverted, is not revertable, or nothing is left to revert.

get.description: Direct child resellers with an active membership and the amount each owes.

post.description:
Returns the webhook resource WITH the HMAC `secret`. This is the only
time the secret is returned — store it now or rotate via
`POST /me/webhooks/{webhook}/rotate-secret` to obtain a new one.
Issues a new signing secret. The previous one stops working immediately.

Queues the oldest 100 deliveries from the last 7 days with status
`dead_letter`, `cancelled_integration_expired` or
`cancelled_webhook_deleted`, or `pending` deliveries never sent and
queued over an hour ago. Each is sent again with the same body,
including the event `id`, and a new signature. Call again while
`remaining` is above 0. The webhook must be active (`422` otherwise).

Sends a `dead_letter`, cancelled, or stuck `pending` delivery (never
sent, queued over an hour ago) again with the same body and a new
signature. Other deliveries, or a paused webhook, return `422`.

Queues a `webhook.test` delivery signed like any other event, whatever
events the webhook subscribes to. The webhook must be active.

post.summary: Credits were added to a reseller
Credits were removed from a reseller
Test delivery sent from the panel
post.description: `data.webhook_id` is the webhook ID. Acknowledge it like any other event.

bearerAuth.description:
Reseller API token created from the panel's Reseller API integration
page. The plaintext is shown exactly once. Each token is limited to
its granted scopes and, optionally, to specific source IPs/CIDRs.

panelSessionAuth.description:
Panel Sanctum session credential of a logged-in panel user. A Reseller
API token is NOT accepted here; these operations are managed from the
panel's Reseller API integration page.

BatchId.name: batch
BatchId.description: Hashid of a DNS change batch (`batch_id` in history rows).

membership.description: The token owner's own membership and the amount owed to their parent reseller. Cost settings are not returned.

value.description: Percent 1-100 for `PERCENTAGE`; amount in cents for `FIXED`.

state.description: Whether checkout accepts the code now.

used_count.description: Checkout orders created with the coupon, paid or not. Counts toward `max_uses`.

paid_count.description: Paid orders that used the coupon.

customer_id.description: Only this customer can use the coupon.

package_id.description: The discount applies only when paying for this package.

value.description: Percent 1-100 for `PERCENTAGE`; amount in cents for `FIXED`.

max_uses.description: Null or 0 means unlimited. Use 1 for a single-use coupon.

valid_from.description: ISO 8601. Without an offset, UTC is used.

valid_until.description: ISO 8601. Without an offset, UTC is used. Must be in the future and after `valid_from`.

customer_id.description: Hashid of one of your own customers.

package_id.description: Hashid of an active non-trial package from `GET /packages`. With `customer_id`, it must be on that customer's server.

CustomerUpdate.description: All fields optional on update. Mirrors the panel customer update form for the API-writable subset.

ResellerUpdate.description: All fields optional on update. Mirrors the panel reseller update form for the API-writable subset.

note.description: Optional note stored in the credit transaction history.

reference.description: Optional integration reference stored in the credit transaction history.

private_note.description: Optional private note visible only to its author.

secret.description: HMAC signing secret. Shown ONCE on create / rotate.

url.description: HTTPS required. Internal hosts / private IP ranges are rejected.

event.description: Subscribed event name, or webhook.test for test deliveries.

replay_count.description: Times this delivery was resent from the panel.

replayable.description: True when this delivery can be resent (dead_letter, cancelled, or pending and never sent for over an hour).

membership_total.description: Amount due for the next membership renewal, in cents (1500 = 15.00). Null when the membership is inactive. While membership_amount_locked is true, this is the amount saved at expiry.

membership_total_count.description: Counted connections (non-trial, unexpired, including the reseller's downline) on servers that count toward membership.

dns.description: Your own DNS; null when unset.

inherited_dns.description: DNS used when you have none.

purchased.description: The DNS host is a purchased domain owned by someone else.

dns.description: New DNS URL; null clears it.

WebhookEnvelope.description:
Body POSTed by Sigma to your webhook endpoint. Verify the
`X-Sigma-Signature: t=<unix_timestamp>,v1=<hex>` header against the
raw body before parsing — see `x-hmac-verification`.

id.description: Event ID (ULID). Identical on every retry of the same event; use it to deduplicate.

event.description: Subscribed event name, or webhook.test for test deliveries.

occurred_at.description: When the event happened (ISO 8601 with UTC offset).

TokenForbidden.description:
The token is not allowed to perform this operation: `ip_not_allowed`
(source IP outside the token's allowlist), `insufficient_scope` (token
lacks this operation's `x-required-scope`) or `permission_denied`
(the account no longer holds the permission the scope requires, or
the panel owner removed the `use reseller api` permission from the
account's role).

IntegrationRequired.description: Reseller API integration subscription required (or expired).

CreditsRequired.description: Insufficient credits to perform the operation.

NotFound.description: Resource not found (or not owned by the actor).

Conflict.description: Resource conflict (e.g. duplicate username, idempotency replay mismatch).

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Authenticated quota per minute; absent for failed-authentication throttling.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Remaining authenticated quota; zero when exhausted.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the authenticated quota resets; only on 429.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before another request.

DeliveryReplayResult.description: Deliveries queued now and eligible deliveries still waiting.

WebhookWithSecret.description: Webhook resource WITH the signing secret (shown once).

GenericReport.description: Paginated report rows; row fields depend on the endpoint.

MembershipReport.description: Direct child resellers with an active membership, ordered by expiry, each with the amount owed.

x-hmac-verification.description:
Sigma signs every webhook POST with HMAC-SHA256 using the webhook's
current signing secret (returned once on creation or rotation; rotating
invalidates the previous secret immediately).

Header format: `X-Sigma-Signature: t=<unix_timestamp>,v1=<hex>`

- `t`: Unix time in seconds when this delivery attempt was signed.
  Every retry is signed again with a new `t`.
- `v1`: lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of the signed payload
  `<t>.<raw_body>`: the `t` value, a literal `.`, then the exact request
  body bytes.

The header has no `sha256=` prefix, and `v1` is not an HMAC of the body
alone. To verify:

1. Parse the header as comma-separated `key=value` pairs. Do not rely on
   field order; ignore unknown keys.
2. Reject the delivery if `t` is more than 300 seconds away from your
   clock (replay protection).
3. Compute `hex(HMAC_SHA256(secret, t + "." + raw_body))` over the raw
   bytes received. Parsing and re-encoding the JSON changes the bytes and
   breaks verification.
4. Compare with `v1` in constant time. Reject missing or invalid
   signatures with `401`.

Other delivery headers: `X-Sigma-Event` (event name),
`X-Sigma-Delivery-Id` (unique per attempt) and `X-Sigma-Webhook-Id`.
Deduplicate on the body `id`, which stays the same across retries and panel resends.
